name: Kettlethorpe
blurb: A short drive from Kettlethorpe — straight down past Standbridge Lane and you're with us.
metaDescription: Dog grooming near Kettlethorpe, Wakefield — a 7-minute drive to Keith's K9 Care home salon in Hall Green WF4. One dog at a time, prices published. Book today.
lead: A short drive from Kettlethorpe — straight down past Standbridge Lane — Keith's K9 Care is a calm, one-to-one home dog grooming salon.
body: Kettlethorpe is a straightforward seven-minute run down to us, past Standbridge Lane and into Hall Green. It's an easy one to fit around the school run or a day's work — drop the dog with Keith, get on with your day, and collect a freshly-groomed dog later. Parking is right outside on Castle Meadows.

What sets Keith's K9 Care apart from a high-street salon is the calm. It's a home salon: one dog at a time, in a quiet purpose-built room, with no kennels and no other dogs barking through the wall. That suits the puppies, nervous dogs and older dogs who find a busy commercial salon overwhelming, and it means your dog has Keith's full attention from start to finish.

Keith is IPET-qualified and grooms every coat type — full grooms, puppy first grooms, bath and tidy, nail trims, de-matting and hand stripping. Prices are published with breed examples so you know roughly what to expect, and Keith confirms the figure in person before he starts work.
Booking your Kettlethorpe dog in is a quick call, WhatsApp or message. A quick chat about your dog first means Keith can set aside the right amount of time for the coat and temperament.

faqs.q: How far is the salon from Kettlethorpe?
faqs.a: About 2.5 miles — a seven-minute drive down past Standbridge Lane to Castle Meadows in Hall Green (WF4).

faqs.q: Can you fit a groom around the school run?
faqs.a: Usually, yes — a drop-off and pick-up works well for a lot of our Kettlethorpe families. Keith will agree the timing when you book.

faqs.q: When can my puppy start grooming?
faqs.a: Usually from around 12 weeks, after the second vaccination. The calm home setup is ideal for a gentle first experience that sets them up for life.

faqs.q: Do you cover the WF2 area around Kettlethorpe?
faqs.a: Yes, Kettlethorpe and the surrounding WF2 streets are firmly within our patch, and a fair few Kettlethorpe families are regulars. The salon is a seven-minute run down past Standbridge Lane to Hall Green, WF4. No drive into the town centre is needed.

faqs.q: Do you hand strip terriers and schnauzers from Kettlethorpe?
faqs.a: Yes, Keith trained in traditional hand stripping, which preserves the colour and texture of a wire coat far better than clipping. It suits breeds like schnauzers, Border terriers and working cockers. Let him know the breed when booking so the extra time it needs is set aside.

The salon runs Tuesday to Friday, 9am to 5pm, and Saturday mornings until 2pm, closed Sundays and Mondays. Those hours fit a drop-off around the school run or a working day. They are flexible too, so message 07926 471552 if you need something different.
